text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... hm-hmm...♪ Fou~nd you, Captains♪ 
Hey, how about some "Carrot 
Yatsuhashi"............ Oh?

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
—There was a report of a suspicious 
individual spotted along that route last 
week. 
Having Her Highness pass through there 
poses some security concerns...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I see, then let's go around from the 
opposite side. 
It's a bit of a detour, but we should be 
able to take this bus.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be better to travel entirely 
by car? 
I can arrange it right away.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
............ In truth, that would be the 
safest option, but... 
I want to give her a "normal student 
trip."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
So please, let's keep tomorrow's 
arrangements similar to today's. 
I truly appreciate your cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: (...Looks like they're in a meeting.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fine? What are you doing? 
Ah......... Another security meeting, huh.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Another"... So they've been doing this 
all the time? 
Bubble-san has...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She said she'd handle it. 
No need to worry. Let's just wait for her 
report.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, take your bath and get 
to sleep. 
We have an early start tomorrow too.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"—I was having so much fun that I had 
forgotten all about it until that moment. 
Even though if anything were to happen, 
someone would be held responsible..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Ohh...! Look at this. 
It says there's a shop in the next town 
offering a "pottery-making experience."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that sounds fun! It might be a bit of 
a rush, 
but if we run there, it shouldn't 
interfere with the next schedule. Want to 
try it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Well, go on ahead without me, 
everyone! 
I'll wait here with the security detail.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Are you tired? We have been moving around 
since morning, after all. 
Shall we find a place to sit down?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm fine! Don't worry about me. 
I just wanted to take a look around this 
area a bit more♪

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...? I wonder if Fine is okay. 
Did we drag her around too much...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"No, she has plenty of stamina. 
...She might just be worried about the 
hassle of changing our schedule."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, what? Why so suddenly...? 
Did something happen?"

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
"How careless of me...! The security 
detail is tighter than usual, yes, but... 
To think that's what made Her Highness 
hold back when she was having so much 
fun."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I see, so that's it. 
...Alright, let's do something about 
this!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Do something, huh? 
As always, you make it sound so simple."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Because I have you, and we have the SPs 
too. 
That's why we can do it."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I declare right here and now: 
I'm going to make her laugh from the 
bottom of her heart again!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...So, is there anything Fine might 
enjoy? 
Air Groove, surely you have an idea or 
two?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"You just assumed I would, didn't you? 
Let me think..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"—Oh wow, Japanese harps are placed on the 
floor!? 
We had an antique harp in our family 
vault, so I used to play it from time to 
time."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"If I ever get the chance to run in Kyoto, 
I wonder if we could stop by here? 
This koto workshop—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"A koto workshop...!  
If it was featured in a magazine last 
year, could it be this one?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that's the one. 
...How did you know, though?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, what a huge coincidence... or 
maybe it's fate? 
I actually know this place! Let me go make 
a quick call!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh? Do you have an idea?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, what do you two think about pottery 
making?♪ 
...? Did something happen?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, no. 
Actually, about that koto you mentioned 
before..."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"—All set! Looks like we're good to go! 
Is it okay if dinner's pushed back a bit?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...! You're already done? 
What kind of magic did you just pull off?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Hahaha! You'll just have to wait and see! 
Fine, let's go. I'm going to give you the 
best memory ever!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wait, what...?
